findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

A knife on the magnetic strip is observed to be soiled on both sides of the blade. It is believed that the blade was not completely cleaned prior to storage. The PIC was shown and moved the knife to dish for recleaning. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are completely cleaned prior to storage.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.citation_text:
5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

The faucet to the right of the dish machine appears to have a persistent leak at the time of this inspection. The PIC was shown and instructed to repair prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all plumbing is maintained in good repair at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

The wall siding to the right of a shelf behind the register is observed pulling away from the wall and allowing for crumb accumulation. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean and reseal the siding prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

Several locations throughout the facility are in need of minor repairs. Locations include: 1) the end of the bar on the salad prep cooler has a ball of tape being used as a safety measure; 2) the wall siding to the right of the front prep cooler is pulling away and exposing a gap that is not easily cleanable; 3) multiple small holes are observed in the wall above the mop sink; 4) several small holes on the side of the walk in cooler; 5) the paint on the wall next to the CFPM certificates is observed with a pair of bald spots where a rough surface is exposed. These locations were discussed with the PIC and they were instructed to repair prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all surfaces around food and moisture are maintained in a smooth and easily cleanable state at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple items throughout the kitchen and prep areas do not appear to have been completely cleaned prior to storage. These items were shown to the PIC and moved back to dish for re-cleaning to correct. Ensure that all dishes and utensils are completely cleaned prior to storage.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.citation_text:
4-904.11(A) Kitchenware and Tableware. (A) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of FOOD and lip-contact surfaces is prevented.

1) Multiple tray lids are stored on a shelf soiled with old oil. Multiple loads are stored in a container with crumbs/dust in the bottom. Both items were shown to the PIC and they were moved to dish for re-cleaning. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are stored so that they remain free of potential contamination prior to use.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. 

Multiple bowls to the right of the slicing station are observed with food splash on them. It is assumed that tomatoes being sliced on the table next to them are spraying onto them. The PIC was consulted and the bowls moved to dish for re-cleaning. Ensure that cleaned/sanitized food contact items are protected from contamination until use. A shield of some kind was discussed as well as moving the bowls to another location.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. 

The metal along the right side of the mop sink appears to have come loose from the sink, exposing a gap that is not easily cleanable. The PIC was consulted and instructed to re-seal it prior to the next routine inspection.
